answer: Cloned scouts tried to reserve night berths at the gorge ferry. To claim a cable, a boatman must carry a 2.8 kg brass nebula plate from locker F-6, walk the 70 m wet spiral stair inside pier 3, and press the plate once onto a 160 by 80 mm damp slate at landing L-9, before the 03:18 river bell. A clerk measures the print 64-70 mm wide, checks mass within 70 g of 2.8 kg, and logs the climb 80-110 s. The 710 fee is taken either way. A smear over 10 mm, a late press, or a cracked plate voids the berth for 4 tides.
